description:
Calculate an auditable GHG inventory from explicit activity records.
    Returns per-line gas/CO2e results, Scope 1/2/3 and category rollups, dual
    Scope 2 reporting, indeterminate lines, factor lineage, notary payload, and
    an offset-clearinghouse dry-run weave. This is calculation, not advice.
    Price: $1.00 per call after 10 free calls/day. Pay at
    /x402/ghg-ledger/calculate_inventory with Base USDC, cash-fund payment_ref
    through escrow_checkout + confirm_escrow_funding, or use /seats.
    Each activity needs activity_type, quantity, unit, region and year (the
    year the activity took place; the latest bundled factor dated on or before
    it is used and recorded on the line). list_factor_packs names the bundled
    activity types and regions. One activity object is accepted as a list of one.
    If a call returns indeterminate, the response includes first_call_help.
    Example arguments: {"activities": [{"id": "office-electricity", "activity_type": "purchased_electricity", "quantity": "12000", "unit": "kWh", "region": "US", "year": 2023}, {"id": "backup-generator", "activity_type": "stationary_combustion_diesel", "quantity": "400", "unit": "gallons", "region": "US", "year": 2025}], "options": {}}

Activity.description: One measured activity: what happened, how much, where and when.

activity_type.description: What the activity is. One of: business_travel_air, business_travel_bus, business_travel_passenger_car, business_travel_rail, mobile_combustion_diesel, mobile_combustion_gasoline, purchased_electricity, purchased_goods_spend, refrigerant_hfc_134a, refrigerant_hfc_32, stationary_combustion_diesel, stationary_combustion_natural_gas, stationary_combustion_propane, waste_landfilled_mixed_msw. Plain words such as electricity or power are read as purchased_electricity, and the line says so.
activity_type.title: Activity Type

flight_haul.description: Only for business_travel_air: short (under 300 miles per flight), medium (300 to 2300 miles) or long (2300 miles and over). Send one line per haul.
flight_haul.title: Flight Haul

id.description: Your label for this line; it is echoed in the result.
id.title: Id

mobile_source_class.description: Only for mobile fuels. on_road for trucks, vans and cars (either fuel); nonroad_four_stroke for non-road gasoline equipment; nonroad for non-road diesel equipment.
mobile_source_class.title: Mobile Source Class

quantity.description: Amount in `unit`, zero or more. A number or a decimal string.
quantity.title: Quantity

region.description: Where it happened. One of: GLOBAL, UK, US, US-AKGD, US-AKMS, US-AZNM, US-CAMX, US-ERCT, US-FRCC, US-HIMS, US-HIOA, US-MROE, US-MROW, US-NEWE, US-NWPP, US-NYCW, US-NYLI, US-NYUP, US-PRMS, US-RFCE, US-RFCM, US-RFCW, US-RMPA, US-SPNO, US-SPSO, US-SRMV, US-SRMW, US-SRSO, US-SRTV, US-SRVC. The US-XXXX codes are EPA eGRID grid subregions, for electricity only (US-CAMX California, US-ERCT Texas, US-NYUP upstate New York, US-RFCE Mid-Atlantic, and so on); use US for fuels and when the subregion is unknown; GLOBAL is for refrigerants. For electricity, a US state name or code (Vermont, VT) is read as its eGRID subregion only when the state sits in one subregion; a split state such as Texas comes back indeterminate with the subregions to choose from.
region.title: Region

unit.description: Unit of `quantity`. Electricity: kWh or MWh. Natural gas: therm, mmbtu or kWh. Liquid fuels: gallon_us or litre. Refrigerants: kg or lb. Landfilled waste: short_ton or metric_tonne. Car travel: mile or km. Air, rail and bus travel: passenger_mile or km (passenger-km). Purchased goods by spend: usd.
unit.title: Unit

year.description: The year the activity took place. The latest bundled factor dated on or before it is used and recorded on the line.
year.title: Year

Activity.title: Activity

activities.description: The activities to inventory: a list of {activity_type, quantity, unit, region, year}. One object or a JSON string is also accepted.
activities.title: Activities

options.description: Optional. Settings, for example factor_year_policy or offset_buyer.
options.title: Options

payment_ref.description: Optional. A paid credit or payment reference, used only after the free daily calls. Leave it out to use the free tier or a seat.
payment_ref.title: Payment Ref

request_id.description: Optional. Your id for this call. Repeat it to retry safely: the same request_id is never charged twice.
request_id.title: Request Id
